import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    static final int MAXN = 410;
    static final int MAXM = 200020;
    static final int[][] dir = {{-1, 0}, {0, 1}, {1, 0}, {0, -1}};

    static int[] firstEdge = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] vertex = new int[MAXM];
    static int[] nextEdge = new int[MAXM];
    static int[] capacity = new int[MAXM];
    static int[] usedFlow = new int[MAXM];
    static int edgeCnt;
    static int[] height = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] current = new int[MAXN];
    static int sourceNode, sinkNode;

    static class SimpleQueue {
        int[] a = new int[100000];
        int head, tail;
        void clear() { head = tail = 0; }
        void push(int x) { a[tail++] = x; }
        void pop() { ++head; }
        int front() { return a[head]; }
        boolean empty() { return head == tail; }
    }

    static void initGraph() {
        Arrays.fill(firstEdge, -1);
        edgeCnt = 0;
    }

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int c) {
        vertex[edgeCnt] = v;
        nextEdge[edgeCnt] = firstEdge[u];
        capacity[edgeCnt] = c;
        usedFlow[edgeCnt] = 0;
        firstEdge[u] = edgeCnt++;

        vertex[edgeCnt] = u;
        nextEdge[edgeCnt] = firstEdge[v];
        capacity[edgeCnt] = 0;
        usedFlow[edgeCnt] = 0;
        firstEdge[v] = edgeCnt++;
    }

    static boolean buildLevels() {
        Arrays.fill(height, -1);
        SimpleQueue q = new SimpleQueue();
        q.clear();
        height[sourceNode] = 0;
        q.push(sourceNode);
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front();
            q.pop();
            for (int e = firstEdge[u]; e != -1; e = nextEdge[e]) {
                int v = vertex[e];
                if (height[v] == -1 && capacity[e] > usedFlow[e]) {
                    height[v] = height[u] + 1;
                    q.push(v);
                }
            }
        }
        return height[sinkNode] != -1;
    }

    static int augment(int u, int pushed) {
        if (u == sinkNode || pushed == 0) return pushed;
        int sent = 0;
        int e = current[u];
        while (e != -1) {
            int v = vertex[e];
            if (height[v] == height[u] + 1 && capacity[e] > usedFlow[e]) {
                int tmp = augment(v, Math.min(pushed, capacity[e] - usedFlow[e]));
                if (tmp > 0) {
                    usedFlow[e] += tmp;
                    usedFlow[e ^ 1] -= tmp;
                    pushed -= tmp;
                    sent += tmp;
                    if (pushed == 0) {
                        current[u] = e;
                        return sent;
                    }
                }
            }
            e = nextEdge[e];
        }
        current[u] = e;
        return sent;
    }

    static int maxflow(int s, int t) {
        sourceNode = s;
        sinkNode = t;
        int ans = 0;
        while (buildLevels()) {
            System.arraycopy(firstEdge, 0, current, 0, firstEdge.length);
            ans += augment(sourceNode, INF);
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static int[][] tim = new int[12][12];
    static int[][] dist = new int[12][12];
    static char[][] g = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static char[][] h = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int n, limitTime;

    static boolean inside(int x, int y) {
        return x >= 0 && x < n && y >= 0 && y < n;
    }

    static void bfs1(int sx, int sy) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) Arrays.fill(tim[i], INF);
        SimpleQueue q = new SimpleQueue();
        q.clear();
        q.push(sx * 10 + sy);
        tim[sx][sy] = 0;
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int x = q.front() / 10, y = q.front() % 10;
            q.pop();
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nx = x + dir[k][0], ny = y + dir[k][1];
                if (inside(nx, ny) && g[nx][ny] >= '0' && g[nx][ny] <= '9' && tim[nx][ny] > tim[x][y] + 1) {
                    tim[nx][ny] = tim[x][y] + 1;
                    q.push(nx * 10 + ny);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void bfs2(int sx, int sy) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) Arrays.fill(dist[i], INF);
        SimpleQueue q = new SimpleQueue();
        q.clear();
        q.push(sx * 10 + sy);
        dist[sx][sy] = 0;
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int x = q.front() / 10, y = q.front() % 10;
            q.pop();
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nx = x + dir[k][0], ny = y + dir[k][1];
                if (inside(nx, ny) && h[nx][ny] >= '0' && h[nx][ny] <= '9' && dist[nx][ny] > dist[x][y] + 1) {
                    if (tim[nx][ny] >= dist[x][y] + 1) {
                        dist[nx][ny] = dist[x][y] + 1;
                        if (tim[nx][ny] > dist[nx][ny])
                            q.push(nx * 10 + ny);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        limitTime = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) g[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) h[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
                if (g[i][j] == 'Z')
                    bfs1(i, j);

        int S = 0, T = n * n * 2 + 1;
        initGraph();

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (g[i][j] > '0' && g[i][j] <= '9')
                    addEdge(S, i * n + j + 1, g[i][j] - '0');
                if (h[i][j] > '0' && h[i][j] <= '9')
                    addEdge(n * n + i * n + j + 1, T, h[i][j] - '0');
            }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
                if (g[i][j] > '0' && g[i][j] <= '9') {
                    bfs2(i, j);
                    for (int x = 0; x < n; ++x)
                        for (int y = 0; y < n; ++y)
                            if (h[x][y] > '0' && h[x][y] <= '9' && dist[x][y] <= limitTime)
                                addEdge(i * n + j + 1, n * n + x * n + y + 1, INF);
                }

        System.out.println(maxflow(S, T));
        sc.close();
    }
}
